note: Skill points model. In-game the skill tree boosts specific attributes; the exact node-by-node effects were not verifiable from a free public source, so this uses a simplified model: one skill point spent on a main stat raises that stat by 'gain_per_point'. The upgrade planner treats 'spend 1 point on stat X for player P' as a candidate upgrade. Edit gain_per_point (or per-stat overrides) to taste.
